8.8.d: याभिः कण्वं मेधातिथिं याभिर्वशं दशव्रजम् । याभिर्गोशर्यमावतं ताभिर्नोऽवतं नरा ॥
8.8.e: Aid us, O Heroes, for those hymns for which ye helped GoSarya erst,  Gave Vaśa, Dasavraja aid, and Kaṇva and Medhatithi:

8.8.d: याभिर्नरा त्रसदस्युमावतं कृत्व्ये धने । ताभिः ष्व१स्माँ अश्विना प्रावतं वाजसातये ॥
8.8.e: And favoured Trasadasyu, ye Heroes, in spoil-deciding fray:  For these, O Aśvins, graciously assist us in acquiring strength.

8.8.d: प्र वां स्तोमाः सुवृक्तयो गिरो वर्धन्त्वश्विना । पुरुत्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं पुरुस्पृहा ॥
8.8.e: O Aśvins, may pure hymns of ours, and songs and praises, honour you:  Best slayers everywhere of foes, as such we fondly yearn for you.

8.8.d: त्रीणि पदान्यश्विनोराविः सान्ति गुहा परः । कवी ऋतस्य पत्मभिरर्वाग्जीवेभ्यस्परि ॥
8.8.e: Three places of the Aśvins, erst concealed, are made apparent now.  Both Sages, with the flight of Law come hither unto those who live.

8.9.d: आ नूनमश्विना युवं वत्सस्य गन्तमवसे । प्रास्मै यच्छतमवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिर्युयुतं या अरातयः ॥
8.9.e: To help and favour Vatsa now, O Aśvins, come ye hitherward.  Bestow on him a dwelling spacious and secure, and keep malignities away.

8.9.d: यदन्तरिक्षे यद्दिवि यत्पञ्च मानुषाँ अनु । नृम्णं तद्धत्तमश्विना ॥
8.9.e: All manliness that is in heaven, with the Five Tribes, or in mid-air,  Bestow, ye Aśvins, upon us.

8.9.d: ये वां दंसांस्यश्विना विप्रासः परिमामृशुः । एवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ॥
8.9.e: Remember Kaṇva first of all among the singers, Aśvins, who  Have thought upon your wondrous deeds.

8.9.d: अयं वां घर्मो अश्विना स्तोमेन परि षिच्यते । अयं सोमो मधुमान्वाजिनीवसू येन वृत्रं चिकेतथः ॥
8.9.e: Aśvins, for you with song of praise this hot oblation is effused,  This your sweet Soma juice, ye Lords of ample wealth, through which ye think upon the foe.

8.9.d: यदप्सु यद्वनस्पतौ यदोषधीषु पुरुदंससा कृतम् । तेन माविष्टमश्विना ॥
8.9.e: Whatever ye have done in floods, in the tree, Wonder-Workers, and in growing plants,  Therewith, O Aśvins, succour me.

8.9.d: यन्नासत्या भुरण्यथो यद्वा देव भिषज्यथः । अयं वां वत्सो मतिभिर्न विन्धते हविष्मन्तं हि गच्छथः ॥
8.9.e: What force, Nāsatyas, ye exert, whatever, Gods, ye tend and heal,  This your own Vatsa gains not by his hymns alone: ye visit him who offers gifts.

8.9.d: आ नूनमश्विनोर्ऋषिः स्तोमं चिकेत वामया । आ सोमं मधुमत्तमं घर्मं सिञ्चादथर्वणि ॥
8.9.e: Now hath the Ṛṣi splendidly thought out the Aśvins' hymn of praise.  Let the Atharvan pour the warm oblation forth, and Soma very rich in sweets.

8.9.d: आ नूनं रघुवर्तनिं रथं तिष्ठाथो अश्विना । आ वां स्तोमा इमे मम नभो न चुच्यवीरत ॥
8.9.e: Ye Aśvins, now ascend your car that lightly rolls upon its way.  May these my praises make you speed hitherward like a cloud of heaven.

8.9.d: यदद्य वां नासत्योक्थैराचुच्युवीमहि । यद्वा वाणीभिरश्विनेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ॥
8.9.e: When, O Nāsatyas, we this day make you speed hither with our hymns,  Or, Aśvins, with our songs of praise, remember Kanya specially.

8.9.d: यद्वां कक्षीवाँ उत यद्व्यश्व ऋषिर्यद्वां दीर्घतमा जुहाव । पृथी यद्वां वैन्यः सादनेष्वेवेदतो अश्विना चेतयेथाम् ॥
8.9.e: As erst Kakṣīvān and the Ṛṣi Vyaśva, as erst Dīrghatamas invoked your presence,  Or, in the sacrificial chambers, Vainya Pṛthi, so be ye mindful of us here, O Aśvins.

8.9.d: यातं छर्दिष्पा उत नः परस्पा भूतं जगत्पा उत नस्तनूपा । वर्तिस्तोकाय तनयाय यातम् ॥
8.9.e: Come as home-guardians, saving us from foemen, guarding our living creatures and our bodies,  Come to the house to give us seed and offspring,

8.9.d: यदिन्द्रेण सरथं याथो अश्विना यद्वा वायुना भवथः समोकसा । यदादित्येभिर्ऋभुभिः सजोषसा यद्वा विष्णोर्विक्रमणेषु तिष्ठथः ॥
8.9.e: Whether with Indra ye be faring, Aśvins, or resting in one dwelling-place with Vāyu,  In concord with the Ṛbhus or Ādityas, or standing still in Viṣṇu's striding-places.

8.9.d: यदद्याश्विनावहं हुवेय वाजसातये । यत्पृत्सु तुर्वणे सहस्तच्छ्रेष्ठमश्विनोरवः ॥
8.9.e: When I, O Aśvins, call on you to-day that I may gather strength,  Or as all-conquering might in war, be that the Aśvins' noblest grace.

8.9.d: आ नूनं यातमश्विनेमा हव्यानि वां हिता । इमे सोमासो अधि तुर्वशे यदाविमे कण्वेषु वामथ ॥
8.9.e: Now come, ye Aśvins, hitherward: here are oblations set for you;  These Soma-draughts to aid Yadu and  Turvaśa, these offered you mid Kaniva's Sons.

8.9.d: यन्नासत्या पराके अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजम् । तेन नूनं विमदाय प्रचेतसा छर्दिर्वत्साय यच्छतम् ॥
8.9.e: Whatever healing balm is yours, Nisatyas, near or far away,  Therewith, great Sages, grant a home to Vatsa and to Vimada.

8.9.d: अभुत्स्यु प्र देव्या साकं वाचाहमश्विनोः । व्यावर्देव्या मतिं वि रातिं मर्त्येभ्यः ॥
8.9.e: Together with the Goddess, with the Aśvins' Speech have I awoke.  Thou, Goddess, hast disclosed the hymn, and holy gift from mortal men.

8.9.d: प्र बोधयोषो अश्विना प्र देवि सूनृते महि । प्र यज्ञहोतरानुषक्प्र मदाय श्रवो बृहत् ॥
8.9.e: Awake the Aśvins, Goddess Dawn! Up Mighty Lady of sweet strains!  Rise, straightway, priest of sacrifice! High glory to the gladdening draught!

8.9.d: यदुषो यासि भानुना सं सूर्येण रोचसे । आ हायमश्विनो रथो वर्तिर्याति नृपाय्यम् ॥
8.9.e: Thou, Dawn, approaching with thy light shinest together with the Sun,  And to this man-protecting home the chariot ofthe Aśvins comes.

8.9.d: यदापीतासो अंशवो गावो न दुह्र ऊधभिः । यद्वा वाणीरनूषत प्र देवयन्तो अश्विना ॥
8.9.e: When yellow stalks give forth the juice, as cows from udders pour their milk,  And voices sound the song of praise, the Aśvins' worshippers show first.

8.9.d: प्र द्युम्नाय प्र शवसे प्र नृषाह्याय शर्मणे । प्र दक्षाय प्रचेतसा ॥
8.9.e: Forward for glory and for strength, protection that shall conquer men,  And power and skill, most sapient Ones!

8.9.d: यन्नूनं धीभिरश्विना पितुर्योना निषीदथः । यद्वा सुम्नेभिरुक्थ्या ॥
8.9.e: When Aśvins, worthy of our lauds, ye seat you in the father's house.  With wisdom or the bliss ye bring.

8.10.d: यत्स्थो दीर्घप्रसद्मनि यद्वादो रोचने दिवः । यद्वा समुद्रे अध्याकृते गृहेऽत आ यातमश्विना ॥
8.10.e: WHETHER ye travel far away or dwell in yonder light of heaven,  Or in a mansion that is built above the sea, come thence, ye Aśvins, hitherward.

8.10.d: यद्वा यज्ञं मनवे सम्मिमिक्षथुरेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् । बृहस्पतिं विश्वान्देवाँ अहं हुव इन्द्राविष्णू अश्विनावाशुहेषसा ॥
8.10.e: Or if for Manu.ye prepared the sacrifice, remember also Kaṇva's son.  I call Bṛhaspati, Indra, Viṣṇu, all the gods, the Aśvins borne by rapid steeds.

8.10.d: त्या न्व१श्विना हुवे सुदंससा गृभे कृता । ययोरस्ति प्र णः सख्यं देवेष्वध्याप्यम् ॥
8.10.e: Those Aśvins I invoke who work marvels, brought hither to receive,  With whom our friendship is most famed, and kinship passing that of Gods.

8.10.d: ययोरधि प्र यज्ञा असूरे सन्ति सूरयः । ता यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य प्रचेतसा स्वधाभिर्या पिबतः सोम्यं मधु ॥
8.10.e: On whom the solemn rites depend, whose worshippers rise without the Sun:  These who foreknow the holy work of sacrifice, and by their Godhead drink the sweets of Soma juice.

8.10.d: यदद्याश्विनावपाग्यत्प्राक्स्थो वाजिनीवसू । यद्द्रुह्यव्यनवि तुर्वशे यदौ हुवे वामथ मा गतम् ॥
8.10.e: Whether ye, Lords of ample wealth, now linger in the cast or west,  With Druhyu, or with Anu, Yadu, Turvaga, I call you hither; come to me.

8.10.d: यदन्तरिक्षे पतथः पुरुभुजा यद्वेमे रोदसी अनु । यद्वा स्वधाभिरधितिष्ठथो रथमत आ यातमश्विना ॥
8.10.e: Lords of great riches, whether through the firmament ye fly or speed through heaven and earth,  Or with your Godlike natures stand upon your cars, come thence, O Aśvins, hitherward.

8.11.d: त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा । त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः ॥
8.11.e: THOU Agni, God mid mortal men, art guard of sacred rites, thou art  To be adored at sacrifice.

8.11.d: त्वमसि प्रशस्यो विदथेषु सहन्त्य । अग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् ॥
8.11.e: O Mighty Agni, thou must be glorified at our festivals,  Bearing our offerings to the Gods.

8.11.d: स त्वमस्मदप द्विषो युयोधि जातवेदः । अदेवीरग्ने अरातीः ॥
8.11.e: O Jātavedas Agni, fight and drive our foes afar from us,  Themand their godless enmities.

8.11.d: अन्ति चित्सन्तमह यज्ञं मर्तस्य रिपोः । नोप वेषि जातवेदः ॥
8.11.e: Thou, Jātavedas, seekest not the worship of a hostile man,  However nigh itbe to thee.

8.11.d: मर्ता अमर्त्यस्य ते भूरि नाम मनामहे । विप्रासो जातवेदसः ॥
8.11.e: We sages, mortals as we are, adore the mighty name oof thee,  Immortal Jātavedas' name.

8.11.d: विप्रं विप्रासोऽवसे देवं मर्तास ऊतये । अग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
8.11.e: Sages, we call the Sage to help, mortals, we call the God to aid:  We call on Agni with our songs.

8.11.d: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् । अग्ने त्वांकामया गिरा ॥
8.11.e: May Vatsa draw- thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place,  Agni, with song that yearns for thee.

8.11.d: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
8.11.e: Thou art the same in many a place: mid all the people thou art Lord.  In fray and fightt we call on thee.
When we are seeking strength we call Agni to help us in the strife,  The giver of rich gifts in war.

8.11.d: प्रत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि । स्वां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रयस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व ॥
8.11.e: Ancient, adorablie at sacrifices, Priest from of old, meet for our praise, thou sittest.  Fill full and satisfy thy body, Agni, and win us happiness by offering worship.

8.12.d: य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति । येना हंसि न्य१त्रिणं तमीमहे ॥
8.12.e: JOY, Mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma-draughts, wherewith  Thou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we long.

8.12.d: येना दशग्वमध्रिगुं वेपयन्तं स्वर्णरम् । येना समुद्रमाविथा तमीमहे ॥
8.12.e: Wherewith thou bolpest Adhrigu, the great Daśagva, and the God  Who stirs the sunlight, and the sea, for that we long.

8.12.d: येन सिन्धुं महीरपो रथाँ इव प्रचोदयः । पन्थामृतस्य यातवे तमीमहे ॥
8.12.e: Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floods  To go the way ordained by Law, for that we long.

8.12.d: इमं स्तोममभिष्टये घृतं न पूतमद्रिवः । येना नु सद्य ओजसा ववक्षिथ ॥
8.12.e: Accept this laud for aid, made pure like oil, thou Caster of the Stone,  Whereby even in a moment thou hast waxen great.

8.12.d: इमं जुषस्व गिर्वणः समुद्र इव पिन्वते । इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्ववक्षिथ ॥
8.12.e: Be pleased, Song-lover, with this song it flows abundant like the sea.  Indra, with all thy succours thou hast waxen great.

8.12.d: यो नो देवः परावतः सखित्वनाय मामहे । दिवो न वृष्टिं प्रथयन्ववक्षिथ ॥
8.12.e: The God who from afar hath sent gifts to maintain our friendship's bond,  Thou. spreading them like rain from heaven, hast waxen great.

8.12.d: ववक्षुरस्य केतव उत वज्रो गभस्त्योः । यत्सूर्यो न रोदसी अवर्धयत् ॥
8.12.e: The beams that mark him have grown strong, the thunder rests between his arms,  When, like the Sun, he hath increased both Heaven and Earth.

8.12.d: यदि प्रवृद्ध सत्पते सहस्रं महिषाँ अघः । आदित्त इन्द्रियं महि प्र वावृधे ॥
8.12.e: When, Mighty Lord of Heroes, thou didst cat a thousand buffaloes,  Then grew and waxed exceeding great thine Indra-power.

8.12.d: इन्द्रः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्न्यर्शसानमोषति । अग्निर्वनेव सासहिः प्र वावृधे ॥
8.12.e: Indra consumeth with the rays of Sūrya the malicious man:  Like Agni conquering the woods, he hath grown strong.

8.12.d: इयं त ऋत्वियावती धीतिरेति नवीयसी । सपर्यन्ती पुरुप्रिया मिमीत इत् ॥
8.12.e: This newest thought of ours that suits the time approaches unto thee:  Serving, beloved in many a place it metes and marks.

8.12.d: गर्भो यज्ञस्य देवयुः क्रतुं पुनीत आनुषक् । स्तोमैरिन्द्रस्य वावृधे मिमीत इत् ॥
8.12.e: The pious germ of sacrifice directly purifies the soul.  By Indra's lauds it waxes great, it metes and marks.

8.12.d: सनिर्मित्रस्य पप्रथ इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये । प्राची वाशीव सुन्वते मिमीत इत् ॥
8.12.e: Indra who wins the friend hath spread himself to drink the Soma-draught:  Like worshipper's dilating praise; it metes and marks.

8.12.d: यं विप्रा उक्थवाहसोऽभिप्रमन्दुरायवः । घृतं न पिप्य आसन्यृतस्य यत् ॥
8.12.e: He whom the sages, living men, have gladdened, offering up their hymns,  Hath swelled like oil of sacrifice in Agni's mouth.

8.12.d: उत स्वराजे अदितिः स्तोममिन्द्राय जीजनत् । पुरुप्रशस्तमूतय ऋतस्य यत् ॥
8.12.e: Aditi also hath brought forth a hymn for Indra, Sovran Lord:  The work of sacrifice for help is glorified.

8.12.d: अभि वह्नय ऊतयेऽनूषत प्रशस्तये । न देव विव्रता हरी ऋतस्य यत् ॥
8.12.e: The ministering priests have sung their songs for aid and eulogy:  God, thy Bays turn not from the rite which Law ordains.

8.12.d: यत्सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये । यद्वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः ॥
8.12.e: If, Indra, thou drink Soma by Viṣṇu's or Tṛta Āptya's side,  Or with the Maruts take delight in flowing drops;

8.12.d: यद्वा शक्र परावति समुद्रे अधि मन्दसे । अस्माकमित्सुते रणा समिन्दुभिः ॥
8.12.e: Or, Śakra, if thou gladden thee afar or in the sea of air,  Rejoice thee in this juice of ours, in flowing drops.

8.12.d: यद्वासि सुन्वतो वृधो यजमानस्य सत्पते । उक्थे वा यस्य रण्यसि समिन्दुभिः ॥
8.12.e: Or, Lord of Heroes if thou aid the worshipper who shed; the, juice,  Or him whose laud delights thee, and his flowing drops.

8.12.d: देवंदेवं वोऽवस इन्द्रमिन्द्रं गृणीषणि । अधा यज्ञाय तुर्वणे व्यानशुः ॥
8.12.e: To magnify the God, the God, Indra, yea, Indra for your help,  And promptly end the sacrifice-this have they gained.

8.12.d: यज्ञेभिर्यज्ञवाहसं सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् । होत्राभिरिन्द्रं वावृधुर्व्यानशुः ॥
8.12.e: With worship, him whom men adore, with Soma, him who drinks it most,  Indra with lauds have they increasedthis have they gained.

8.12.d: महीरस्य प्रणीतयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः । विश्वा वसूनि दाशुषे व्यानशुः ॥
8.12.e: His leadings are with power and might and his instructions manifold:  He gives the worshipper all wealth: this have they gained.

8.12.d: इन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे देवासो दधिरे पुरः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषता समोजसे ॥
8.12.e: For slaying Vṛtra have the Gods set Indra in the foremost place.  Indra the choral bands have sung, for vigorous strength.

8.12.d: महान्तं महिना वयं स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुतम् । अर्कैरभि प्र णोनुमः समोजसे ॥
8.12.e: We to the Mighty with our might, with lauds to him who hears our call,  With holy hymns have sung aloud, for vigorous strength.

8.12.d: न यं विविक्तो रोदसी नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् । अमादिदस्य तित्विषे समोजसः ॥
8.12.e: Not earth, nor heaven, nor firmaments contain the Thunder-wielding God:  They shake before his violent rush and vigorous strength.

8.12.d: यदिन्द्र पृतनाज्ये देवास्त्वा दधिरे पुरः । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
8.12.e: What time the Gods, O Indra, get thee foremost in the furious fight,  Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

8.12.d: यदा वृत्रं नदीवृतं शवसा वज्रिन्नवधीः । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
8.12.e: When Vṛtra, stayer of the floods, thou si"est, Thundeicr with might,  Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

8.12.d: यदा ते विष्णुरोजसा त्रीणि पदा विचक्रमे । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
8.12.e: When Viṣṇu, through thine energy, strode wide those three great steps of his,  Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

8.12.d: यदा ते हर्यता हरी वावृधाते दिवेदिवे । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
8.12.e: When thy two beautiful Bay Steeds grew great and greater day by day,  Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

8.12.d: यदा ते मारुतीर्विशस्तुभ्यमिन्द्र नियेमिरे । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
8.12.e: When, Indra, all the Marut folk humbly submitted them to thee,  Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

8.12.d: यदा सूर्यममुं दिवि शुक्रं ज्योतिरधारयः । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
8.12.e: When yonder Sun, that brilliant light, thou settest in the heaven above,  Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

8.12.d: इमां त इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं विप्र इयर्ति धीतिभिः । जामिं पदेव पिप्रतीं प्राध्वरे ॥
8.12.e: To thee, O Indra, with this thought the sage lifts up this eulogy,  Akin and leading as on foot to sacrifice.

8.12.d: यदस्य धामनि प्रिये समीचीनासो अस्वरन् । नाभा यज्ञस्य दोहना प्राध्वरे ॥
8.12.e: When in thine own dear dwelling all gathered have lifted up the voice  Milk-streams at worship's central spot, for sacrifice,

8.12.d: सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं सुगव्यमिन्द्र दद्धि नः । होतेव पूर्वचित्तये प्राध्वरे ॥
8.12.e: As Priest, O Indra, give us wealth in brave men and good steeds ana kine  That we may first remember thee for sacrifice.

8.13.d: इन्द्रः सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीत उक्थ्यम् । विदे वृधस्य दक्षसो महान्हि षः ॥
8.13.e: INDRA, when Soma juices flow, makes his mind pure and meet for lauds.  He gains the power that brings success, for great is he.

8.13.d: स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानां सदने वृधः । सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित् ॥
8.13.e: In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success,  Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the water-floods.

8.13.d: तमह्वे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणम् । भवा नः सुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वृधे ॥
8.13.e: Him, to win strength, have I invoked, even Indra mighty for the fray.  Be thou most near to us for bliss, a Friend to aid.

8.13.d: इयं त इन्द्र गिर्वणो रातिः क्षरति सुन्वतः । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
8.13.e: Indra, Song -lover, here for thee the worshipper's libation flows.  Rejoicing in this sacred grass thou shinest forth.

8.13.d: नूनं तदिन्द्र दद्धि नो यत्त्वा सुन्वन्त ईमहे । रयिं नश्चित्रमा भरा स्वर्विदम् ॥
8.13.e: Even now, O Indra, give us that which, pressing juice, we crave of thee.  Bring us wealth manifold which finds the light of heaven.

8.13.d: स्तोता यत्ते विचर्षणिरतिप्रशर्धयद्गिरः । वया इवानु रोहते जुषन्त यत् ॥
8.13.e: What time the zealous worshipper hath boldly sung his songs to thee,  Like branches of a tree up-grows what they desire.

8.13.d: प्रत्नवज्जनया गिरः शृणुधी जरितुर्हवम् । मदेमदे ववक्षिथा सुकृत्वने ॥
8.13.e: Generate songs even as of old, give car unto the singer's call.  Thou for the pious hast grown great at each carouse.

8.13.d: क्रीळन्त्यस्य सूनृता आपो न प्रवता यतीः । अया धिया य उच्यते पतिर्दिवः ॥
8.13.e: Sweet strains that glorify him play like waters speeding down a slope,  Yea, him who in this song is called the Lord of Heaven;

8.13.d: उतो पतिर्य उच्यते कृष्टीनामेक इद्वशी । नमोवृधैरवस्युभिः सुते रण ॥
8.13.e: Yea, who alone is called the Lord, the single Ruler of the folk,  By worshippers seeking aid: may he joy in the draught.

8.13.d: स्तुहि श्रुतं विपश्चितं हरी यस्य प्रसक्षिणा । गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहं नमस्विनः ॥
8.13.e: Praise him, the Glorious, skilled in song, Lord of the two victorious Bays:  They seek the worshipper's abode who bows in prayer.

8.13.d: तूतुजानो महेमतेऽश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः । आ याहि यज्ञमाशुभिः शमिद्धि ते ॥
8.13.e: Put forth thy strength: with dappled Steeds come, thou of mighty intellect,  With swift Steeds to the sacrifice, for ’tis thy joy.

8.13.d: इन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते रयिं गृणत्सु धारय । श्रवः सूरिभ्यो अमृतं वसुत्वनम् ॥
8.13.e: Grant wealth to those who praise thee, Lord of Heroes, Mightiest Indra: give  Our princes everlasting fame and opulence.

8.13.d: हवे त्वा सूर उदिते हवे मध्यंदिने दिवः । जुषाण इन्द्र सप्तिभिर्न आ गहि ॥
8.13.e: I call thee when the Sun is risen, I call thee at the noon of day:  With thy car-horses, Indra, come wellpleased to us.

8.13.d: आ तू गहि प्र तु द्रव मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः । तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं यथा विदे ॥
8.13.e: Speed forward hither, come to us, rejoice thee in the milky draught:  Spin out the thread of ancient time, as well is known.

8.13.d: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । यद्वा समुद्रे अन्धसोऽवितेदसि ॥
8.13.e: If, Śakra, Vṛtra-slayer, thou be far away or near to us.  Or in the sea, thou art the guard of Soma juice.

8.13.d: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तु नो गिर इन्द्रं सुतास इन्दवः । इन्द्रे हविष्मतीर्विशो अराणिषुः ॥
8.13.e: Let songs we sing and Soma-drops expressed by us make Indra strong:  The tribes who bring oblations find delight in him.

8.13.d: तमिद्विप्रा अवस्यवः प्रवत्वतीभिरूतिभिः । इन्द्रं क्षोणीरवर्धयन्वया इव ॥
8.13.e: Him sages longing for his aid, with offerings brought in eager haste,  Him. even as branches, all mankind have made to grow.

8.13.d: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः सदावृधम् ॥
8.13.e: At the Trkadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirred the mind:  May our songs strengthen him who still hath strengthened us.

8.13.d: स्तोता यत्ते अनुव्रत उक्थान्यृतुथा दधे । शुचिः पावक उच्यते सो अद्भुतः ॥
8.13.e: When, true to duty, at due times the worshipper offers lauds to thee,  They call him Purifier, Pure, and Wonderful.

8.13.d: तदिद्रुद्रस्य चेतति यह्वं प्रत्नेषु धामसु । मनो यत्रा वि तद्दधुर्विचेतसः ॥
8.13.e: That mind of Rudra, fresh and strong, moves conscious in the ancient ways,  With reference whereto the wise have ordered this.

8.13.d: यदि मे सख्यमावर इमस्य पाह्यन्धसः । येन विश्वा अति द्विषो अतारिम ॥
8.13.e: If thou elect to be my Friend drink of this sacrificial juice,  By help whereof we may subdue all enemies.

8.13.d: कदा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः स्तोता भवाति शंतमः । कदा नो गव्ये अश्व्ये वसौ दधः ॥
8.13.e: O Indra, Lover of the song, when shall thy praiser be most blest?  When wilt thou grant us wealth in herds of kine and steeds?

8.13.d: उत ते सुष्टुता हरी वृषणा वहतो रथम् । अजुर्यस्य मदिन्तमं यमीमहे ॥
8.13.e: And thy two highIy-lauded Bays, strong stallions, draw thy car who art  Untouched by age, most gladdening car for which we pray.

8.13.d: तमीमहे पुरुष्टुतं यह्वं प्रत्नाभिरूतिभिः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सददध द्विता ॥
8.13.e: With ancient offerings we implore the Young and Strong whom many praise.  He from of old hath sat upon dear sacred grass.

8.13.d: वर्धस्वा सु पुरुष्टुत ऋषिष्टुताभिरूतिभिः । धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषमवा च नः ॥
8.13.e: Wax miglity, thou whom many laud for aids which Ṛṣis have extolled.  Pour down for us abundant food and guard us well.

8.13.d: इन्द्र त्वमवितेदसीत्था स्तुवतो अद्रिवः । ऋतादियर्मि ते धियं मनोयुजम् ॥
8.13.e: O Indra, Caster of the Stone, thou helpest him who praises thee:  From sacrifice I send to thee a mindyoked hymn.

8.13.d: इह त्या सधमाद्या युजानः सोमपीतये । हरी इन्द्र प्रतद्वसू अभि स्वर ॥
8.13.e: Here, yoking for the Soma-draught these Horses, sharers of thy feast,  Thy Bay Steeds, Indra, fraught with weal tb, consent to come.

8.13.d: अभि स्वरन्तु ये तव रुद्रासः सक्षत श्रियम् । उतो मरुत्वतीर्विशो अभि प्रयः ॥
8.13.e: Attendants on thy glory, let the Rudras roar assent to thee,  And all the Marut companies come tothe feast.

8.13.d: इमा अस्य प्रतूर्तयः पदं जुषन्त यद्दिवि । नाभा यज्ञस्य सं दधुर्यथा विदे ॥
8.13.e: These his victorious followers bold in the heavens the place they love,  Leagued in the heart of sacrifice, as well we know.

8.13.d: अयं दीर्घाय चक्षसे प्राचि प्रयत्यध्वरे । मिमीते यज्ञमानुषग्विचक्ष्य ॥
8.13.e: That we may long behold the light, what time the ordered rite proceeds,  He duly measures, as he views, the sacrifice.

8.13.d: वृषायमिन्द्र ते रथ उतो ते वृषणा हरी । वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो वृषा हवः ॥
8.13.e: O Indra, strong is this thy car, and strong are these Bay Steeds of thine:  O Śatakratu, thou art strong, strong is our call.

8.13.d: वृषा ग्रावा वृषा मदो वृषा सोमो अयं सुतः । वृषा यज्ञो यमिन्वसि वृषा हवः ॥
8.13.e: Strong is the press-stone, strong thy joy, strong is the flowing Soma juice:  Strong is the rite thou furtherest, strong is our call.

8.13.d: वृषा त्वा वृषणं हुवे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः । वावन्थ हि प्रतिष्टुतिं वृषा हवः ॥
8.13.e: As strong I call on thee the Strong, O Thunderer with thy thousand aids:  For thou hast won the hymn of praise. Strong is our call.

8.14.d: यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् । स्तोता मे गोषखा स्यात् ॥
8.14.e: IF I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single Sovran of all wealth,  My worshipper should be rich in kine.

8.14.d: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे । यदहं गोपतिः स्याम् ॥
8.14.e: I should be fain, O Lord of Power, to strengthen and enrich the sage,  Were I the Lord of herds of kine.

8.14.d: धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते । गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे ॥
8.14.e: To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow  Yielding in plenty kine and steeds.

8.14.d: न ते वर्तास्ति राधस इन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यः । यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम् ॥
8.14.e: None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence,  The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.

8.14.d: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् । चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥
8.14.e: The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth, and made  Himself a diadem in heaven.

8.14.d: वावृधानस्य ते वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः । ऊतिमिन्द्रा वृणीमहे ॥
8.14.e: Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great  Hast won all treasures for thine own.
In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light,  When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

8.14.d: उद्गा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः । अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम् ॥
8.14.e: Showing the hidden he drave forth the cows for the Aṅgirases,  And Vala he cast headlong down.

8.14.d: इन्द्रेण रोचना दिवो दृळ्हानि दृंहितानि च । स्थिराणि न पराणुदे ॥
8.14.e: By Indra were the lumirious realms of heaven established and secured,  Firm and immovable from their place.

8.14.d: अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव स्तोम इन्द्राजिरायते । वि ते मदा अराजिषुः ॥
8.14.e: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods:  Bright shine the drops that gladden thee.

8.14.d: त्वं हि स्तोमवर्धन इन्द्रास्युक्थवर्धनः । स्तोतॄणामुत भद्रकृत् ॥
8.14.e: For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify:  Thou blessest those who worship thee.

8.14.d: इन्द्रमित्केशिना हरी सोमपेयाय वक्षतः । उप यज्ञं सुराधसम् ॥
8.14.e: Let the two long-maned Bay Steeds bring Indra to drink the Soma juice,  The Bountiful to our sacrifice.

8.14.d: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः । विश्वा यदजयः स्पृधः ॥
8.14.e: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuci,  Subduing all contending hosts.
The Dasyus, when they fain would climb  by magic arts and mount to heaven,  Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.

8.14.d: असुन्वामिन्द्र संसदं विषूचीं व्यनाशयः । सोमपा उत्तरो भवन् ॥
8.14.e: As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side  Their settlement who poured no gifts.

8.15.d: तम्वभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत ॥
8.15.e: SING forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud.  Invite the powerful Indra with your songs of praise.

8.15.d: यस्य द्विबर्हसो बृहत्सहो दाधार रोदसी । गिरीँरज्राँ अपः स्वर्वृषत्वना ॥
8.15.e: Whose lofty might-for doubly strong is he-supports the heavens and earth,  And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power.

8.15.d: स राजसि पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे । इन्द्र जैत्रा श्रवस्या च यन्तवे ॥
8.15.e: Such, Praised by many! thou art King alone thou smitest Vṛtras dead,  To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.

8.15.d: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृत्सु सासहिम् । उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम् ॥
8.15.e: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray,  Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.

8.15.d: येन ज्योतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
8.15.e: Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Āyu and for Manu's sake:  Now joying in this sacred grass thou beamest forth.

8.15.d: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा । वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे ॥
8.15.e: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine:  Win thou the waters day by day, thralls of the strong.

8.15.d: तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव शुष्ममुत क्रतुम् । वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम् ॥
8.15.e: That lofty Indra-power of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence,  Thy thunderbolt for which we long, the wish makes keen.

8.15.d: तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौंस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः । त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे ॥
8.15.e: O Indra, Heaven and Earth augment thy manly power and thy renown;  The waters and thy mountains stir and urge thee on.

8.15.d: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः । त्वां शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम् ॥
8.15.e: Viṣṇu the lofty ruling Power, Varuṇa, Mitra sing thy praise:  In thee the Marut3' company have great delight.

8.15.d: त्वं वृषा जनानां मंहिष्ठ इन्द्र जज्ञिषे । सत्रा विश्वा स्वपत्यानि दधिषे ॥
8.15.e: O Indra, thou wast born the Lord of men, most liberal of thy gifts:  Excellent deeds for evermore are all thine own.

8.15.d: सत्रा त्वं पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि तोशसे । नान्य इन्द्रात्करणं भूय इन्वति ॥
8.15.e: Ever, alone, O highly-praised, thou sendest Vṛtras to their rest:  None else than Indra executes the mighty deed.

8.15.d: यदिन्द्र मन्मशस्त्वा नाना हवन्त ऊतये । अस्माकेभिर्नृभिरत्रा स्वर्जय ॥
8.15.e: Though here and there, in varied hymns, Indra, men call on thee for aid,  Still with our heroes fight and win the light of heaven.

8.15.d: अरं क्षयाय नो महे विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन् । इन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षया शचीपतिम् ॥
8.15.e: Already have all forms of him entered our spacious dwelling-place:  For victory stir thou Indra, up, the Lord of Might.

8.16.d: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः । नरं नृषाहं मंहिष्ठम् ॥
8.16.e: PRAISE Indra whom our songs must laud, sole Sovran of mankind, the Chief  Most liberal who controlleth men.

8.16.d: यस्मिन्नुक्थानि रण्यन्ति विश्वानि च श्रवस्या । अपामवो न समुद्रे ॥
8.16.e: In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs.  Like the floods' longing for the sea.

8.16.d: तं सुष्टुत्या विवासे ज्येष्ठराजं भरे कृत्नुम् । महो वाजिनं सनिभ्यः ॥
8.16.e: Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight,  Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.

8.16.d: यस्यानूना गभीरा मदा उरवस्तरुत्राः । हर्षुमन्तः शूरसातौ ॥
8.16.e: Whose perfect ecstasies are wide, profound, victorious, and give  joy in the field where heroes win.
Him, when the spoils of war are staked, men call to be their advocate:  They who have Indra win the day.

8.16.d: तमिच्च्यौत्नैरार्यन्ति तं कृतेभिश्चर्षणयः । एष इन्द्रो वरिवस्कृत् ॥
8.16.e: Men honour him with stirring songs and magnify with solemn rites:  Indra is he who giveth case.

8.16.d: इन्द्रो ब्रह्मेन्द्र ऋषिरिन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः । महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
8.16.e: Indra is priest and Ṛṣi, he is much invoked by many men,  And mighty by his mighty powers.

8.16.d: स स्तोम्यः स हव्यः सत्यः सत्वा तुविकूर्मिः । एकश्चित्सन्नभिभूतिः ॥
8.16.e: Meet to be lauded and invoked, true Hero with his deeds of might,  Victorious even when alone.

8.16.d: तमर्केभिस्तं सामभिस्तं गायत्रैश्चर्षणयः । इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति क्षितयः ॥
8.16.e: The men, the people magnify that Indra with their Slina. songs,  With hymns and sacred eulogies

8.16.d: प्रणेतारं वस्यो अच्छा कर्तारं ज्योतिः समत्सु । सासह्वांसं युधामित्रान् ॥
8.16.e: Him who advances them to wealth, sends light to lead them in the war,  And quells their foemen in the fray.

8.16.d: स नः पप्रिः पारयाति स्वस्ति नावा पुरुहूतः । इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः ॥
8.16.e: May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship  Safely beyond all enemies.

8.16.d: स त्वं न इन्द्र वाजेभिर्दशस्या च गातुया च । अच्छा च नः सुम्नं नेषि ॥
8.16.e: As such, O Indra, honour us with gifts of booty, further us,  And lead us to felicity.

8.17.d: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् । एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
8.17.e: COME, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here  Sit thou on this my sacred grass.

8.17.d: आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु ॥
8.17.e: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward  Give car and listen to our prayers.

8.17.d: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः । सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
8.17.e: We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend,  We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.

8.17.d: आ नो याहि सुतावतोऽस्माकं सुष्टुतीरुप । पिबा सु शिप्रिन्नन्धसः ॥
8.17.e: Come unto us who bring the juice, come unto this our eulogy,  Fair-visored! drink thou of the juice.

8.17.d: आ ते सिञ्चामि कुक्ष्योरनु गात्रा वि धावतु । गृभाय जिह्वया मधु ॥
8.17.e: I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it spread:  Take with. thy tongue the pleasant drink.

8.17.d: स्वादुष्टे अस्तु संसुदे मधुमान्तन्वे३ तव । सोमः शमस्तु ते हृदे ॥
8.17.e: Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice:  Sweet be the Soma to thine heart.

8.17.d: अयमु त्वा विचर्षणे जनीरिवाभि संवृतः । प्र सोम इन्द्र सर्पतु ॥
8.17.e: Like women, let this Soma-draught, invested with its robe, approach,  O active Indra, close to thee.

8.17.d: तुविग्रीवो वपोदरः सुबाहुरन्धसो मदे । इन्द्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
8.17.e: Indra, transported with the juice, vast in his bulk, strong in his neck  And stout arms, smites the Vṛtras down.

8.17.d: इन्द्र प्रेहि पुरस्त्वं विश्वस्येशान ओजसा । वृत्राणि वृत्रहञ्जहि ॥
8.17.e: O Indra, go thou forward, thou who rulest over all by might:  Thou Vṛtra-slayer slay the fiends,

8.17.d: दीर्घस्ते अस्त्वङ्कुशो येना वसु प्रयच्छसि । यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
8.17.e: Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest ample wealth to him  Who sheds the juice and worships thee.

8.17.d: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥
8.17.e: Here, Indra, is thy Soma-draught, made pure upon the sacred grass:  Run hither, come and drink thereof.

8.17.d: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायं रणाय ते सुतः । आखण्डल प्र हूयसे ॥
8.17.e: Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well this juice is shed for thy delight  Thou art invoked, Akhandala!

8.17.d: यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो नपात्प्रणपात्कुण्डपाय्यः । न्यस्मिन्दध्र आ मनः ॥
8.17.e: To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Srngavrs! to thee,  To him have I addressed my thought.

8.17.d: वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणांसत्रं सोम्यानाम् । द्रप्सो भेत्ता पुरां शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनां सखा ॥
8.17.e: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home armour of Soma-offerers:  The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Ṛṣis’ Friend.

8.17.d: पृदाकुसानुर्यजतो गवेषण एकः सन्नभि भूयसः । भूर्णिमश्वं नयत्तुजा पुरो गृभेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
8.17.e: Holy Prdikusanu, winner of the spoil, one eminent o’er many men,  Lead on the wild horse Indra with his vigorous grasp forward to drink the Soma juice.

8.18.d: इदं ह नूनमेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः । आदित्यानामपूर्व्यं सवीमनि ॥
8.18.e: Now let the mortal offer prayer to win the unexampled grace  Of these Ādityas and their aid to cherish life.

8.18.d: अनर्वाणो ह्येषां पन्था आदित्यानाम् । अदब्धाः सन्ति पायवः सुगेवृधः ॥
8.18.e: For not an enemy molests the paths which these Ādityas tread:  Infallible guards, they strengthen us in happiness.

8.18.d: तत्सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथो यदीमहे ॥
8.18.e: Now soon may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman  Give us the shelter widely spread which we implore.

8.18.d: देवेभिर्देव्यदितेऽरिष्टभर्मन्ना गहि । स्मत्सूरिभिः पुरुप्रिये सुशर्मभिः ॥
8.18.e: With Gods come thou whose fostering care none checks, O Goddesss Aditi:  Come, dear to many, with the Lords who guard us well.

8.18.d: ते हि पुत्रासो अदितेर्विदुर्द्वेषांसि योतवे । अंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयोऽनेहसः ॥
8.18.e: For well these Sons of Aditi know to keep enmities aloof,  Unrivalled, giving ample room, they save from woe.

8.18.d: अदितिर्नो दिवा पशुमदितिर्नक्तमद्वयाः । अदितिः पात्वंहसः सदावृधा ॥
8.18.e: Aditi guard our herd by day, Aditi, free from guile, by night,  Aditi, ever strengthening, save us from grief!

8.18.d: उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्या गमत् । सा शंताति मयस्करदप स्रिधः ॥
8.18.e: And in the day our hymn is this: May Aditi come nigh to help,  With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes.

8.18.d: उत त्या दैव्या भिषजा शं नः करतो अश्विना । युयुयातामितो रपो अप स्रिधः ॥
8.18.e: And may the Aśvins, the divine Pair of Physicians, send us health:  May they remove iniquity and chase our foes.

8.18.d: शमग्निरग्निभिः करच्छं नस्तपतु सूर्यः । शं वातो वात्वरपा अप स्रिधः ॥
8.18.e: May Agni bless us with his fires, and Sūrya warm us pleasantly:  May the pure Wind breathe sweet on us, and chase our foes.

8.18.d: अपामीवामप स्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिम् । आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अंहसः ॥
8.18.e: Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity:  Ādityas, keep us ever far from sore distress.

8.18.d: युयोता शरुमस्मदाँ आदित्यास उतामतिम् । ऋधग्द्वेषः कृणुत विश्ववेदसः ॥
8.18.e: Remove from us the arrow, keep famine, Ādityas! far away:  Keep enmities afar from us, Lords of all wealth!

8.18.d: तत्सु नः शर्म यच्छतादित्या यन्मुमोचति । एनस्वन्तं चिदेनसः सुदानवः ॥
8.18.e: Now, O Ādityas, grant to us the shelter that lets man go free,  Yea, even the sinner from his sin, ye Bounteous Gods 1

8.18.d: यो नः कश्चिद्रिरिक्षति रक्षस्त्वेन मर्त्यः । स्वैः ष एवै रिरिषीष्ट युर्जनः ॥
8.18.e: Whatever mortal with the powe r of demons fain would injure us,  May he, impetuous, suffer harm by his own deeds.

8.18.d: समित्तमघमश्नवद्दुःशंसं मर्त्यं रिपुम् । यो अस्मत्रा दुर्हणावाँ उप द्वयुः ॥
8.18.e: May sin o’ertake our human foe, the man who speaketh evil thing,  Him who would cause our misery, whose heart is false.

8.18.d: पाकत्रा स्थन देवा हृत्सु जानीथ मर्त्यम् । उप द्वयुं चाद्वयुं च वसवः ॥
8.18.e: Gods, ye are with the simple ones, ye know each mortal in your hearts;  Ye, Vasus, well discriminate the false and true.

8.18.d: आ शर्म पर्वतानामोतापां वृणीमहे । द्यावाक्षामारे अस्मद्रपस्कृतम् ॥
8.18.e: Fain would we have the sheltering aid of mountains and of water-floods:  Keep far from us iniquity, O Heaven and Earth.

8.18.d: ते नो भद्रेण शर्मणा युष्माकं नावा वसवः । अति विश्वानि दुरिता पिपर्तन ॥
8.18.e: So with auspicious sheltering aid do ye, O Vasus, carry us  Beyond all trouble and distress, borne in your ship.

8.18.d: तुचे तनाय तत्सु नो द्राघीय आयुर्जीवसे । आदित्यासः सुमहसः कृणोतन ॥
8.18.e: Ādityas, ye Most Mighty Ones, grant to our children and their seed  Extended term of life that they may live long days.

8.18.d: यज्ञो हीळो वो अन्तर आदित्या अस्ति मृळत । युष्मे इद्वो अपि ष्मसि सजात्ये ॥
8.18.e: Sacrifice, O Ādityas, is your inward monitor: be kind,  For in the bond of kindred we are bound to you.

8.18.d: बृहद्वरूथं मरुतां देवं त्रातारमश्विना । मित्रमीमहे वरुणं स्वस्तये ॥
8.18.e: The Maruts’ high protecting aid, the Aśvins, and the God who saves,  Mitra and Varuṇa for weal we supplicate.

8.18.d: अनेहो मित्रार्यमन्नृवद्वरुण शंस्यम् । त्रिवरूथं मरुतो यन्त नश्छर्दिः ॥
8.18.e: Grant us a home with triple guard, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa!  Unthreatened, Maruts! meet for praise, and filled with men.

8.18.d: ये चिद्धि मृत्युबन्धव आदित्या मनवः स्मसि । प्र सू न आयुर्जीवसे तिरेतन ॥
8.18.e: And as we human beings, O Ādityas, are akin to death,  Graciously lengthen ye our lives that we may live.

8.19.d: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे । देवत्रा हव्यमोहिरे ॥
8.19.e: SING praise to hiin, the Lord of Light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger,  And sent oblation to Gods.

8.19.d: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीळिष्व यन्तुरम् । अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम् ॥
8.19.e: Agni, the Bounteous Giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari-  Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice.

8.19.d: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥
8.19.e: Thee have we chosen skilftillest in sacrifice, Immortal Priest among the Gods,  Wise finisher of this holy rite:

8.19.d: ऊर्जो नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिमग्निं श्रेष्ठशोचिषम् । स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि ॥
8.19.e: The Son of Strength, the blessed, brightly shining One, Agni whose light is excellent.  May be by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuṇa, and the Floods.

8.19.d: यः समिधा य आहुती यो वेदेन ददाश मर्तो अग्नये । यो नमसा स्वध्वरः ॥
8.19.e: The mortal who hath ministered to Agni with oblation, fuel, ritual lore,  And reverence, skilled in sacrifice.

8.19.d: तस्येदर्वन्तो रंहयन्त आशवस्तस्य द्युम्नितमं यशः । न तमंहो देवकृतं कुतश्चन न मर्त्यकृतं नशत् ॥
8.19.e: Verily swift to run are his fleet-footed steeds, and most resplendent fame is his.  No trouble caused by Gods or wrought by mortal man from any side o’ertaketh him.

8.19.d: स्वग्नयो वो अग्निभिः स्याम सूनो सहस ऊर्जां पते । सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ॥
8.19.e: May we by thine own fires be well supplied with fire, O Son of Strength, O Lord of Might:  Thou as our Friend hast worthy men.

8.19.d: प्रशंसमानो अतिथिर्न मित्रियोऽग्नी रथो न वेद्यः । त्वे क्षेमासो अपि सन्ति साधवस्त्वं राजा रयीणाम् ॥
8.19.e: Agni, who praises like a guest of friendly mind, is as a car that brings us gear.  Also in thee is found perfect security thou art the Sovran Lord of wealth.

8.19.d: सो अद्धा दाश्वध्वरोऽग्ने मर्तः सुभग स प्रशंस्यः । स धीभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
8.19.e: That man, moreover, merits praise who brings, auspicious Agni, sacrificial gifts  May he win riches by his thoughts.

8.19.d: यस्य त्वमूर्ध्वो अध्वराय तिष्ठसि क्षयद्वीरः स साधते । सो अर्वद्भिः सनिता स विपन्युभिः स शूरैः सनिता कृतम् ॥
8.19.e: He for whose sacrifice thou standest up erect is prosperous and rules o’er men.  He wins with coursers and with singers killed in song: with heroes he obtains the prize.

8.19.d: यस्याग्निर्वपुर्गृहे स्तोमं चनो दधीत विश्ववार्यः । हव्या वा वेविषद्विषः ॥
8.19.e: He in whose dwelling Agni is chief ornament, and, all-desired, loves his laud well,  And zealously tends his offerings-

8.19.d: विप्रस्य वा स्तुवतः सहसो यहो मक्षूतमस्य रातिषु । अवोदेवमुपरिमर्त्यं कृधि वसो विविदुषो वचः ॥
8.19.e: His, or the lauding sage's word, his, Son of Strength! who Is most prompt with sacred gifts,  Set thou beneath the Gods, Vasu, above mankind, the speech of the intelligent.

8.19.d: यो अग्निं हव्यदातिभिर्नमोभिर्वा सुदक्षमाविवासति । गिरा वाजिरशोचिषम् ॥
8.19.e: He who with sacrificial gifts or homage bringeth very skilful Agni nigh,  Or him who flashes fast with song,

8.19.d: समिधा यो निशिती दाशददितिं धामभिरस्य मर्त्यः । विश्वेत्स धीभिः सुभगो जनाँ अति द्युम्नैरुद्न इव तारिषत् ॥
8.19.e: The mortal who with blazing fuel, as his laws command, adores the Perfect God,  Blest with his thoughts in splendour shall exceed all men, as though he overpassed the floods.

8.19.d: तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासहत्सदने कं चिदत्रिणम् । मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यः ॥
8.19.e: Give us the splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode,  The wrath of evil-hearted folk.

8.19.d: येन चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा येन नासत्या भगः । वयं तत्ते शवसा गातुवित्तमा इन्द्रत्वोता विधेमहि ॥
8.19.e: That, wherewith Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, the Aśvins, Bhaga give us light,  That may we, by thy power finding best furtherance, worship, O Indra, helped by thee.

8.19.d: ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्यो३ ये त्वा विप्र निदधिरे नृचक्षसम् । विप्रासो देव सुक्रतुम् ॥
8.19.e: O Agni, most devout are they, the sages who have set thee Sage exceeding wise,  O God, for men to look upon:

8.19.d: त इद्वेदिं सुभग त आहुतिं ते सोतुं चक्रिरे दिवि । त इद्वाजेभिर्जिग्युर्महद्धनं ये त्वे कामं न्येरिरे ॥
8.19.e: Who have arranged thine altar Blessed God, at morn brought thine oblation, pressed the juice.  They by their deeds of strength have won diem, mighty wealth, who have set all their hope in thee.

8.19.d: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः । भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥
8.19.e: -May Agni worshipped bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One, and sacrifice bring bliss;  Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.

8.19.d: भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहः । अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः ॥
8.19.e: Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight.  Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.

8.19.d: ईळे गिरा मनुर्हितं यं देवा दूतमरतिं न्येरिरे । यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहनम् ॥
8.19.e: I praise with song the Friend of man, whom Gods sent down to be herald and messenger,  Best worshipper, bearer of our gifts.

8.19.d: तिग्मजम्भाय तरुणाय राजते प्रयो गायस्यग्नये । यः पिंशते सूनृताभिः सुवीर्यमग्निर्घृतेभिराहुतः ॥
8.19.e: Thou unto sharp-toothed Agni, Young and Radiant God, proclaimest with thy song the feast-  Agni, who for our sweet strains moulds heroic strength when sacred oil is offered him,

8.19.d: यदी घृतेभिराहुतो वाशीमग्निर्भरत उच्चाव च । असुर इव निर्णिजम् ॥
8.19.e: While, served with sacrificial oil, now upward and now downward Agni moves his sword,  As doth the Asura his robe.

8.19.d: यो हव्यान्यैरयता मनुर्हितो देव आसा सुगन्धिना । विवासते वार्याणि स्वध्वरो होता देवो अमर्त्यः ॥
8.19.e: The God, the Friend of man, who bears our gifts to heaven, the God with his sweet-smelling mouth,  Distributes, skilled in sacrifice, his precious things, Invoking Priest, Immortal God.

8.19.d: यदग्ने मर्त्यस्त्वं स्यामहं मित्रमहो अमर्त्यः । सहसः सूनवाहुत ॥
8.19.e: Son of Strength, Agni, if thou wert the mortal, bright as Mitra, I worshipped with our gifts!  And I were the Immortal God

8.19.d: न त्वा रासीयाभिशस्तये वसो न पापत्वाय सन्त्य । न मे स्तोतामतीवा न दुर्हितः स्यादग्ने न पापया ॥
8.19.e: I would not give thee up, Vasu, to calumny, or misery, O Bounteous One.  My worshipper should feel no hunger or distress, nor, Agni, should he live in sin.

8.19.d: पितुर्न पुत्रः सुभृतो दुरोण आ देवाँ एतु प्र णो हविः ॥
8.19.e: Like a son cherished in his father's houi§e, let our oblation rise unto the Gods.

8.19.d: तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्नेदिष्ठाभिः सचेय जोषमा वसो । सदा देवस्य मर्त्यः ॥
8.19.e: With thine immediate aid may I, excellent Agni, ever gain my wish  A mortal with a God to help.

8.19.d: तव क्रत्वा सनेयं तव रातिभिरग्ने तव प्रशस्तिभिः । त्वामिदाहुः प्रमतिं वसो ममाग्ने हर्षस्व दातवे ॥
8.19.e: O Agni, by thy wisdom, by thy bounties, by thy leading may I gather wealth.  Excellent Agni, thou art called my Providence: delight thou to be liberal.

8.19.d: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तिरते वाजभर्मभिः । यस्य त्वं सख्यमावरः ॥
8.19.e: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of noble heroes and great strength,  Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.

8.19.d: तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे । त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि ॥
8.19.e: Thy spark is black and crackling, kindled in due time, O Bounteous, it is taken up.  Thou art the dear Friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.

8.19.d: तमागन्म सोभरयः सहस्रमुष्कं स्वभिष्टिमवसे । सम्राजं त्रासदस्यवम् ॥
8.19.e: We Sobharis have come to him, for succour, who is good to help with thousand powers,  The Sovran, Trasadasyu's Friend.

8.19.d: यस्य ते अग्ने अन्ये अग्नय उपक्षितो वया इव । विपो न द्युम्ना नि युवे जनानां तव क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
8.19.e: O Agni, thou on whom all other fires depend, as branches on the parent stem,  I make the treasures of the folk, like songs, mine own, while I exalt thy sovran might.

8.19.d: यमादित्यासो अद्रुहः पारं नयथ मर्त्यम् । मघोनां विश्वेषां सुदानवः ॥
8.19.e: The mortal whom, Ādityas, ye, Guilelew, lead to the farther bank  Of all the princes, Bounteous Ones

8.19.d: यूयं राजानः कं चिच्चर्षणीसहः क्षयन्तं मानुषाँ अनु । वयं ते वो वरुण मित्रार्यमन्त्स्यामेदृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
8.19.e: Whoe’er he be, Man-ruling Kings! the Regent of the race of men-  May we, O Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, like him be furtherers of your law.

8.19.d: अदान्मे पौरुकुत्स्यः पञ्चाशतं त्रसदस्युर्वधूनाम् । मंहिष्ठो अर्यः सत्पतिः ॥
8.19.e: A gift of fifty female slaves hath Trasadasyu given me, Purukutsa's son,  Most liberal, kind, lord of the brave.

8.19.d: उत मे प्रयियोर्वयियोः सुवास्त्वा अधि तुग्वनि । तिसॄणां सप्ततीनां श्यावः प्रणेता भुवद्वसुर्दियानां पतिः ॥
8.19.e: And Śyāva too for me led forth a strong steed at Suvastu's ford:  A herd of three times seventy kine, good lord of gifts, he gave to me.

8.20.d: आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थाता समन्यवः । स्थिरा चिन्नमयिष्णवः ॥
8.20.e: LET none, Swift Travellers! check you: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away,  Ye benders even of what is firm.

8.20.d: वीळुपविभिर्मरुत ऋभुक्षण आ रुद्रासः सुदीतिभिः । इषा नो अद्या गता पुरुस्पृहो यज्ञमा सोभरीयवः ॥
8.20.e: Maruts, Ṛbhukṣans, Rudras come ye with your cars strong-fellied and exceeding bright.  Come, ye for whom we long, with food, to sacrifice, come ye with love to Sobbari.

8.20.d: विद्मा हि रुद्रियाणां शुष्ममुग्रं मरुतां शिमीवताम् । विष्णोरेषस्य मीळ्हुषाम् ॥
8.20.e: For well we know the vigorous might of Rudra's Sons, the Martits, who are passing strong,  Swift Viṣṇu's band, who send the rain.,

8.20.d: वि द्वीपानि पापतन्तिष्ठद्दुच्छुनोभे युजन्त रोदसी । प्र धन्वान्यैरत शुभ्रखादयो यदेजथ स्वभानवः ॥
8.20.e: Islands are bursting forth and misery is stayed: the heaven and earth are joined in one.  Decked with bright rings, ye spread the broad expanses out, when ye, Self. luminous, stirred yourselves.

8.20.d: अच्युता चिद्वो अज्मन्ना नानदति पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः । भूमिर्यामेषु रेजते ॥
8.20.e: Even things immovable shake and reel, the mountains and the forest trees at your approach,  And the earth trembles as ye come.

8.20.d: अमाय वो मरुतो यातवे द्यौर्जिहीत उत्तरा बृहत् । यत्रा नरो देदिशते तनूष्वा त्वक्षांसि बाह्वोजसः ॥
8.20.e: To lend free course, O Maruts, to your furious rush, heaven high and higher still gives way,  Where they, the Heroes mighty with their arms, display their gleaming omaments on their forms.

8.20.d: स्वधामनु श्रियं नरो महि त्वेषा अमवन्तो वृषप्सवः । वहन्ते अह्रुतप्सवः ॥
8.20.e: After their Godlike nature they, the bull. like Heroes, dazzling and impetuous, wear  Great splendour as they show erect.

8.20.d: गोभिर्वाणो अज्यते सोभरीणां रथे कोशे हिरण्यये । गोबन्धवः सुजातास इषे भुजे महान्तो नः स्परसे नु ॥
8.20.e: The pivot of the Sobharis' chariot within the golden box is balmed with milk.  May they the Well-born, Mighty, kindred of the Cow, aid us to food and to delight.

8.20.d: प्रति वो वृषदञ्जयो वृष्णे शर्धाय मारुताय भरध्वम् । हव्या वृषप्रयाव्णे ॥
8.20.e: Bring, ye who sprinkle balmy drops. oblations to your vigorous Marut company,  To those whose leader is the Bull.

8.20.d: वृषणश्वेन मरुतो वृषप्सुना रथेन वृषनाभिना । आ श्येनासो न पक्षिणो वृथा नरो हव्या नो वीतये गत ॥
8.20.e: Come hither, O ye Mares, on your stronghorsed car, solid in look, with solid naves.  Lightly like winged falcons, O ye Heroes, come, come to enjoy our ofrerings.

8.20.d: समानमञ्ज्येषां वि भ्राजन्ते रुक्मासो अधि बाहुषु । दविद्युतत्यृष्टयः ॥
8.20.e: Their decoration is the same: their omaments of gold are bright upon their arms;  Their lances glitter splendidly.

8.20.d: त उग्रासो वृषण उग्रबाहवो नकिष्टनूषु येतिरे । स्थिरा धन्वान्यायुधा रथेषु वोऽनीकेष्वधि श्रियः ॥
8.20.e: They toil not to defend their bodies from attack, strong Heroes with their mighty arms.  Strong are your bows and strong the weapons in your cars, and glory sits on every face.

8.20.d: येषामर्णो न सप्रथो नाम त्वेषं शश्वतामेकमिद्भुजे । वयो न पित्र्यं सहः ॥
8.20.e: Whose name extendeth like a sea, alone, resplendent, so that all have joy in it,  And life-power like ancestral might.

8.20.d: तान्वन्दस्व मरुतस्ताँ उप स्तुहि तेषां हि धुनीनाम् । अराणां न चरमस्तदेषां दाना मह्ना तदेषाम् ॥
8.20.e: Pay honour to these Maruts and sing praise to them, for of the wheel-spokes of the car  Of these loud roarers none is last: this is their power, this moves them to give mighty gifts.

8.20.d: सुभगः स व ऊतिष्वास पूर्वासु मरुतो व्युष्टिषु । यो वा नूनमुतासति ॥
8.20.e: Blest by your favouring help was he, O Maruts, at the earlier flushings of the morn,  And even now shall he be blest.

8.20.d: यस्य वा यूयं प्रति वाजिनो नर आ हव्या वीतये गथ । अभि ष द्युम्नैरुत वाजसातिभिः सुम्ना वो धूतयो नशत् ॥
8.20.e: The strong man to whose sacrifice, O Heroes, ye approach that ye may taste thereof,  With glories and with war that winneth spoil shall gain great bliss, ye Shakers of the world.

8.20.d: यथा रुद्रस्य सूनवो दिवो वशन्त्यसुरस्य वेधसः । युवानस्तथेदसत् ॥
8.20.e: Even as Rudra's Sons, the brood of the Creator Dyaus, the Asura, desire,  O Youthful Ones, so shall it be:

8.20.d: ये चार्हन्ति मरुतः सुदानवः स्मन्मीळ्हुषश्चरन्ति ये । अतश्चिदा न उप वस्यसा हृदा युवान आ ववृध्वम् ॥
8.20.e: And these the bounteous, worthy of the Maruts who move onward pouring down the rain-  Even for their sake, O Youthful Ones, with kindest heart take us to you to be your own.

8.20.d: यून ऊ षु नविष्ठया वृष्णः पावकाँ अभि सोभरे गिरा । गाय गा इव चर्कृषत् ॥
8.20.e: O Sobhari, with newest song sing out unto the youthful purifying Bulls,  Even as a plougher to his steers.

8.20.d: साहा ये सन्ति मुष्टिहेव हव्यो विश्वासु पृत्सु होतृषु । वृष्णश्चन्द्रान्न सुश्रवस्तमान्गिरा वन्दस्व मरुतो अह ॥
8.20.e: Who, like a celebrated boxer, overcome the challengers in every fight:  They who, like shining bulls, are most illustrious-honour those Maruts with thy song.

8.20.d: गावश्चिद्घा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः । रिहते ककुभो मिथः ॥
8.20.e: Allied by common ancestry, ye Maruts, even the Cows, alike in energy,  Lick, all by turns, each other's head.

8.20.d: मर्तश्चिद्वो नृतवो रुक्मवक्षस उप भ्रातृत्वमायति । अधि नो गात मरुतः सदा हि व आपित्वमस्ति निध्रुवि ॥
8.20.e: Even mortal man, ye Dancers breast adorned with gold, attains to brotherhood with you.  Mark ye and notice us, O Maruts; evermore your friendship is secured to us.

8.20.d: मरुतो मारुतस्य न आ भेषजस्य वहता सुदानवः । यूयं सखायः सप्तयः ॥
8.20.e: O Maruts, rich in noble gifts, bring us a portion of the Maruts’ medicine,  Ye Coursers who are Friends to us.

8.20.d: याभिः सिन्धुमवथ याभिस्तूर्वथ याभिर्दशस्यथा क्रिविम् । मयो नो भूतोतिभिर्मयोभुवः शिवाभिरसचद्विषः ॥
8.20.e: Haters of those who serve you not, bliss-bringers, bring us bliss with those auspicious aids  Wherewith ye are victorious and guard Sindhu well, and succour Krvi in his need.

8.20.d: यत्सिन्धौ यदसिक्न्यां यत्समुद्रेषु मरुतः सुबर्हिषः । यत्पर्वतेषु भेषजम् ॥
8.20.e: Maruts, who rest on fair trimmed grass, what balm soever Sindhu or Asikni hath,  Or mountains or the seas contain.

8.20.d: विश्वं पश्यन्तो बिभृथा तनूष्वा तेना नो अधि वोचत । क्षमा रपो मरुत आतुरस्य न इष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
8.20.e: Ye carry on your bodies, ye who see it all: so bless us graciously therewith.  Cast, Maruts, to the ground our sick man's malady: replace the dislocated limb.

8.21.d: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वाजे चित्रं हवामहे ॥
8.21.e: WE call on thee, O Matchless One! We seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves,  Call on thee wonderful in fight

8.21.d: उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् । त्वामिद्ध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम् ॥
8.21.e: On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gonse forth.  We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, havie chosen thee, free-giver, as our Guardian God.

8.21.d: आ याहीम इन्दवोऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते । सोमं सोमपते पिब ॥
8.21.e: Come hither, for the drops are here, O Lord of corn-lands. Lord of horses, Lord of kine:  Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord!

8.21.d: वयं हि त्वा बन्धुमन्तमबन्धवो विप्रास इन्द्र येमिम । या ते धामानि वृषभ तेभिरा गहि विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये ॥
8.21.e: For we the kinless singers have drawn hither thee, O Indra, who hast numerous kin.  With all the forms thou hast, comic thou of bull-like strength, come near to drink the Soma juice.

8.21.d: सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे । अभि त्वामिन्द्र नोनुमः ॥
8.21.e: Sitting like birds beside thy meath., mingled with milk, that gladdeneth and exalteth thee,  Indra, to thee we sing aloud.

8.21.d: अच्छा च त्वैना नमसा वदामसि किं मुहुश्चिद्वि दीधयः । सन्ति कामासो हरिवो ददिष्ट्वं स्मो वयं सन्ति नो धियः ॥
8.21.e: We speak to thee with this our reverential prayer. Why art thou pondering yet awhile?  Here are our wishes; thou art liberal, Lord of Bays: we and our hymns are present here.

8.21.d: नूत्ना इदिन्द्र ते वयमूती अभूम नहि नू ते अद्रिवः । विद्मा पुरा परीणसः ॥
8.21.e: For not in recent times alone, O Indra, Thunder-armed, have we obtained thine aid.  Of old we knew thy plenteous wealth.

8.21.d: विद्मा सखित्वमुत शूर भोज्य१मा ते ता वज्रिन्नीमहे । उतो समस्मिन्ना शिशीहि नो वसो वाजे सुशिप्र गोमति ॥
8.21.e: Hero, we knew thy friendship and thy rich rewards: these, Thunderer, now we crave of thee.  O Vasu, for all wealth that cometh of the kine, sharpen our powers, fair-visored God.

8.21.d: यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु वः स्तुषे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
8.21.e: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you,  Even Indra, O my friends, for help

8.21.d: हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि ष्मा यो अमन्दत । आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवा शतम् ॥
8.21.e: Borne by Bay Steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes; delight.  May Maghavan bestow on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.

8.21.d: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसन्तं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि । संस्थे जनस्य गोमतः ॥
8.21.e: Hero, may we, with thee for Friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath,  In fight with people rich in kine.

8.21.d: जयेम कारे पुरुहूत कारिणोऽभि तिष्ठेम दूढ्यः । नृभिर्वृत्रं हन्याम शूशुयाम चावेरिन्द्र प्र णो धियः ॥
8.21.e: May we be victors in the singer's battlesong, and meet the wicked, Much invoked!  With heroes smite the foeman and show forth our strength. O Indra, further thou our thoughts.

8.21.d: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥
8.21.e: O Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou:  Thou seekest comradeship in war.

8.21.d: नकी रेवन्तं सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः । यदा कृणोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे ॥
8.21.e: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine.  What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a Father, art invoked.

8.21.d: मा ते अमाजुरो यथा मूरास इन्द्र सख्ये त्वावतः । नि षदाम सचा सुते ॥
8.21.e: O Indra, let us not, like fools who waste their lives at home, with friendship such as thine  Sit idly by the poured-out juice.

8.21.d: मा ते गोदत्र निरराम राधस इन्द्र मा ते गृहामहि । दृळ्हा चिदर्यः प्र मृशाभ्या भर न ते दामान आदभे ॥
8.21.e: Giver of kine, may we not miss thy gracious gifts: let us not rob thee of thine own.  Strip even the strong places of the foe, and bring: thy gifts can never be made vain.

8.21.d: इन्द्रो वा घेदियन्मघं सरस्वती वा सुभगा ददिर्वसु । त्वं वा चित्र दाशुषे ॥
8.21.e: Indra or blest Sarasvatī alone bestows such wealth, treasure so great, or thou,  O Citra, on the worshipper.

8.21.d: चित्र इद्राजा राजका इदन्यके यके सरस्वतीमनु । पर्जन्य इव ततनद्धि वृष्ट्या सहस्रमयुता ददत् ॥
8.21.e: Citra is King, and only kinglings are the rest who dwell beside Sarasvatī.  He, like Parjanya with his rain, hath spread himself with thousand, yea, with myriad gifts.

8.22.d: ओ त्यमह्व आ रथमद्या दंसिष्ठमूतये । यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी आ सूर्यायै तस्थथुः ॥
8.22.e: HITHERWARD have I called to-day, for succour, that most wondrous car  Which ye ascended, Aśvins, ye whose paths are red, swift to give Car, for Sūrya's sake.

8.22.d: पूर्वापुषं सुहवं पुरुस्पृहं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम् । सचनावन्तं सुमतिभिः सोभरे विद्वेषसमनेहसम् ॥
8.22.e: Car ever young, much longed-for, easily invoked, soon guided, first in deeds of might,  Which waits and serves, O Sobhari, with benevolence, without a rival or a foe.

8.22.d: इह त्या पुरुभूतमा देवा नमोभिरश्विना । अर्वाचीना स्ववसे करामहे गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
8.22.e: These Aśvins with our homage, these Two Omnipresent Deities  Hitherward will we bring for kind help, these who seek the dwelling of the worshipper.

8.22.d: युवो रथस्य परि चक्रमीयत ईर्मान्यद्वामिषण्यति । अस्माँ अच्छा सुमतिर्वां शुभस्पती आ धेनुरिव धावतु ॥
8.22.e: One of your chariot wheels is moving swiftly round, one speeds for you its onward course.  Like a milch-cow, O Lords of splendour, and with haste let your benevolence come to us.

8.22.d: रथो यो वां त्रिवन्धुरो हिरण्याभीशुरश्विना । परि द्यावापृथिवी भूषति श्रुतस्तेन नासत्या गतम् ॥
8.22.e: That chariot of yours which hath a triple seat and reins of gold,  The famous car that traverseth the heaven and earth, thereon Nāsatyas, Aśvins, come.

8.22.d: दशस्यन्ता मनवे पूर्व्यं दिवि यवं वृकेण कर्षथः । ता वामद्य सुमतिभिः शुभस्पती अश्विना प्र स्तुवीमहि ॥
8.22.e: Ye with your plough, when favouring Manu with your help, ploughed the first harvest in the sky.  As such will we exalt you, Lords of splendour, now, O Aśvins, with our prayer and praise.

8.22.d: उप नो वाजिनीवसू यातमृतस्य पथिभिः । येभिस्तृक्षिं वृषणा त्रासदस्यवं महे क्षत्राय जिन्वथः ॥
8.22.e: Come to us, Lords of ample wealth, by paths of everlasting Law,  Whereby to high dominion ye with mighty strength raised Trksi, Trasadasyu's son.

8.22.d: अयं वामद्रिभिः सुतः सोमो नरा वृषण्वसू । आ यातं सोमपीतये पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे ॥
8.22.e: This Soma pressed with stones is yours, ye Heroes, Lords of plenteous wealth.  Approach to drink the Soma, come, drink in the worshipper's abode.

8.22.d: आ हि रुहतमश्विना रथे कोशे हिरण्यये वृषण्वसू । युञ्जाथां पीवरीरिषः ॥
8.22.e: O Aśvins, mount the chariot, mount the golden seat, ye who are Lords of plenteous wealth,  And bring to us abundant food.

8.22.d: याभिः पक्थमवथो याभिरध्रिगुं याभिर्बभ्रुं विजोषसम् । ताभिर्नो मक्षू तूयमश्विना गतं भिषज्यतं यदातुरम् ॥
8.22.e: The aids wherewith ye helped Paktha and Adhrigt;, and Babhru severed from his friends,—  With those, O Aśvins, come hither with speed and soon, and heal whatever is diseased.

8.22.d: यदध्रिगावो अध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना हवामहे । वयं गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः ॥
8.22.e: When we continually invoke the Aśvins, the resistless, at this time of day,  We lovers of the song, with songs.

8.22.d: ताभिरा यातं वृषणोप मे हवं विश्वप्सुं विश्ववार्यम् । इषा मंहिष्ठा पुरुभूतमा नरा याभिः क्रिविं वावृधुस्ताभिरा गतम् ॥
8.22.e: Through these, ye Mighty Ones, come hither to my call which brings all blessings, wears all forms,—  Tlirough which, All-present Heroes, lavishest of food ye strengthened Krvi, come through these.

8.22.d: ताविदा चिदहानां तावश्विना वन्दमान उप ब्रुवे । ता उ नमोभिरीमहे ॥
8.22.e: I speak to both of these as such, these Aśvins whom I reverence at this time of day:  With homage we entreat them both.

8.22.d: ताविद्दोषा ता उषसि शुभस्पती ता यामन्रुद्रवर्तनी । मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे वाजिनीवसू परो रुद्रावति ख्यतम् ॥
8.22.e: Ye who are Lords of splendour, ye whose paths are red, at eve, at mom, at sacrifice,  Give us not utterly as prey to mortal foe, ye Rudras, Lords of ample wealth.

8.22.d: आ सुग्म्याय सुग्म्यं प्राता रथेनाश्विना वा सक्षणी । हुवे पितेव सोभरी ॥
8.22.e: For bliss I call. the blissful car, at morn the inseparable Aśvins with their car  I call, like Sobhari our sire.

8.22.d: मनोजवसा वृषणा मदच्युता मक्षुंगमाभिरूतिभिः । आरात्ताच्चिद्भूतमस्मे अवसे पूर्वीभिः पुरुभोजसा ॥
8.22.e: Rapid as thought, and strong, and speeding to thejoy, bringing.your swiftly-coming help,  Be to us a protection even from far away Lords of great wealth, with many aids.'

8.22.d: आ नो अश्वावदश्विना वर्तिर्यासिष्टं मधुपातमा नरा । गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ॥
8.22.e: Come, Wonder-Workers, to our home, our home, O Aśvins, rich in cattle, steeds, and gold,  Chief drinkers of the Soma's juice

8.22.d: सुप्रावर्गं सुवीर्यं सुष्ठु वार्यमनाधृष्टं रक्षस्विना । अस्मिन्ना वामायाने वाजिनीवसू विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
8.22.e: Choice-worthy strength, heroic, firm and excellent, uninjured by the Rakṣas foe,  At this your coming nigh, ye Lords of ample wealth and all good things, may we obtain.

8.23.d: ईळिष्वा हि प्रतीव्यं१ यजस्व जातवेदसम् । चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषम् ॥
8.23.e: WORSHIP thou Jātavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts,  Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame.

8.23.d: दामानं विश्वचर्षणेऽग्निं विश्वमनो गिरा । उत स्तुषे विष्पर्धसो रथानाम् ॥
8.23.e: Thou, all men's friend, Visvamanas, exaltest Agni with thy song,  The Giver, and his flames with which no cars contend.

8.23.d: येषामाबाध ऋग्मिय इषः पृक्षश्च निग्रभे । उपविदा वह्निर्विन्दते वसु ॥
8.23.e: Whose resolute assault, to win vigour and food, deserves our praise,—  Through whose discovering power the priest obtaineth wealth.

8.23.d: उदस्य शोचिरस्थाद्दीदियुषो व्य१जरम् । तपुर्जम्भस्य सुद्युतो गणश्रियः ॥
8.23.e: Up springs the imperishable flame, the flame of the Refulgent One  Most bright, with glowing jaws and glory in his train.

8.23.d: उदु तिष्ठ स्वध्वर स्तवानो देव्या कृपा । अभिख्या भासा बृहता शुशुक्वनिः ॥
8.23.e: Skilled in fair sacrifice, extolled, arise in Godlike loveliness,  Shining with lofty splendour, with effulgent light.

8.23.d: अग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिर्हव्या जुह्वान आनुषक् । यथा दूतो बभूथ हव्यवाहनः ॥
8.23.e: Called straight to our oblations, come, O Agni, through our eulogies,  As thou hast been our envoy bearing up our gifts.

8.23.d: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं हुवे होतारं चर्षणीनाम् । तमया वाचा गृणे तमु वः स्तुषे ॥
8.23.e: I call your Agni, from of old Invoking Priest of living men:  Him with this song I laud and magnify for you.

8.23.d: यज्ञेभिरद्भुतक्रतुं यं कृपा सूदयन्त इत् । मित्रं न जने सुधितमृतावनि ॥
8.23.e: Whom, wondrous wise, they animate with solemn rites and his fair form,  Kind as a friend to men who keep the holy Law.

8.23.d: ऋतावानमृतायवो यज्ञस्य साधनं गिरा । उपो एनं जुजुषुर्नमसस्पदे ॥
8.23.e: Him, true to Law, who perfecteth the sacrifice,. Law-loving ones!  Ye with your song have gratified in the place of prayer.

8.23.d: अच्छा नो अङ्गिरस्तमं यज्ञासो यन्तु संयतः । होता यो अस्ति विक्ष्वा यशस्तमः ॥
8.23.e: May all our sacrifices go to him the truest Aṅgiras,  Who is among mankind the most illustrious Priest.

8.23.d: अग्ने तव त्ये अजरेन्धानासो बृहद्भाः । अश्वा इव वृषणस्तविषीयवः ॥
8.23.e: Imperishable Agni, thine are all these high enkindled lights,  Like horses and like stallions showing forth their strength.

8.23.d: स त्वं न ऊर्जां पते रयिं रास्व सुवीर्यम् । प्राव नस्तोके तनये समत्स्वा ॥
8.23.e: So give us, Lord of Power and Might, riches combined with hero strength,  And guard us with our sons and grand. sons in our frays.

8.23.d: यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशि । विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षांसि सेधति ॥
8.23.e: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manti's race,  Agni averteth from us all the demon host.

8.23.d: श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते । नि मायिनस्तपुषा रक्षसो दह ॥
8.23.e: O Hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine,  Burn down the Rākṣasas, enchanters, with thy flame.

8.23.d: न तस्य मायया चन रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः । यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातिभिः ॥
8.23.e: No mortal foe can e’er prevail by arts of magic over him  Who serveth Agni well with sacrificial gifts.

8.23.d: व्यश्वस्त्वा वसुविदमुक्षण्युरप्रीणादृषिः । महो राये तमु त्वा समिधीमहि ॥
8.23.e: Vyaśva the sage, who sought the Bull, hath won thee, finder of good things:  As such may we enkindle thee for ample wealth.

8.23.d: उशना काव्यस्त्वा नि होतारमसादयत् । आयजिं त्वा मनवे जातवेदसम् ॥
8.23.e: Uśanā Kāvya stablished thee, O Agni, as Invoking Priest:  Thee, Jātavedas, Sacrificing Priest for man.

8.23.d: विश्वे हि त्वा सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत । श्रुष्टी देव प्रथमो यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
8.23.e: All Deities of one accord appointed thee their messenger:  Thou, God, through hearing, hadst first claim to sacrifice.

8.23.d: इमं घा वीरो अमृतं दूतं कृण्वीत मर्त्यः । पावकं कृष्णवर्तनिं विहायसम् ॥
8.23.e: Him may the mortal hero make his own immortal messenger.  Far-spreading, Purifier, him whose path is black.

8.23.d: तं हुवेम यतस्रुचः सुभासं शुक्रशोचिषम् । विशामग्निमजरं प्रत्नमीड्यम् ॥
8.23.e: With lifted ladles let us call him splendid with his brilliant flame,  Men's ancient Agni, wasting not, adorable.

8.23.d: यो अस्मै हव्यदातिभिराहुतिं मर्तोऽविधत् । भूरि पोषं स धत्ते वीरवद्यशः ॥
8.23.e: The man who pays the worship due to him with sacrificial gifts  Obtains both plenteous nourishment and hero fame.

8.23.d: प्रथमं जातवेदसमग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् । प्रति स्रुगेति नमसा हविष्मती ॥
8.23.e: To Jātavedas Agni, chief in sacrifices, first of all  With homage goes the ladle rich with sacred gifts.

8.23.d: आभिर्विधेमाग्नये ज्येष्ठाभिर्व्यश्ववत् । मंहिष्ठाभिर्मतिभिः शुक्रशोचिषे ॥
8.23.e: Even as Vyatya did, may we with these most high and liberal hymns  Pay worship unto Agni of the splendid flame.

8.23.d: नूनमर्च विहायसे स्तोमेभिः स्थूरयूपवत् । ऋषे वैयश्व दम्यायाग्नये ॥
8.23.e: Now sing, as Sthurayupa sang, with lands to him who spreadeth far,  To Agni of the home, O Ṛṣi, Vyaśva's son.

8.23.d: अतिथिं मानुषाणां सूनुं वनस्पतीनाम् । विप्रा अग्निमवसे प्रत्नमीळते ॥
8.23.e: As welcome guest of human kind, as offspring of the forest kings,  The sages worship ancient Agni for his aid.

8.23.d: महो विश्वाँ अभि षतो३ऽभि हव्यानि मानुषा । अग्ने नि षत्सि नमसाधि बर्हिषि ॥
8.23.e: For men's oblations brought to him who is the mighty Lord of all,  Sit, Agni, mid our homage, on the sacred grass.

8.23.d: वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु वंस्व रायः पुरुस्पृहः । सुवीर्यस्य प्रजावतो यशस्वतः ॥
8.23.e: Grant us abundant. treasures, grant the opulence which many crave,  With store of heroes, progeny, and high renown.

8.23.d: त्वं वरो सुषाम्णेऽग्ने जनाय चोदय । सदा वसो रातिं यविष्ठ शश्वते ॥
8.23.e: Agni, Most Youthful of the Gods, send evermore the gift of wealth  Unto Varosusaman and to all his folk.

8.23.d: त्वं हि सुप्रतूरसि त्वं नो गोमतीरिषः । महो रायः सातिमग्ने अपा वृधि ॥
8.23.e: A mighty Conqueror art thou, O Agni, so disclose to us  Food in our herds of kine and gain of ample wealth.

8.23.d: अग्ने त्वं यशा अस्या मित्रावरुणा वह । ऋतावाना सम्राजा पूतदक्षसा ॥
8.23.e: Thou, Agni, art a glorious God: bring hither Mitra, Varuṇa,  Imperial Sovrans, holy-minded, true to Law.

8.24.d: सखाय आ शिषामहि ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे । स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे ॥
8.24.e: COMPANIONS, let us learn a prayer to Indra. whom the thunder arms,  To glorify your bold and most heroic Friend.

8.24.d: शवसा ह्यसि श्रुतो वृत्रहत्येन वृत्रहा । मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि ॥
8.24.e: For thou by slaying Vṛtra art the Vṛtra-slayer, famed for might.  Thou, Hero, in rich gifts surpassest wealthy chiefs.

8.24.d: स नः स्तवान आ भर रयिं चित्रश्रवस्तमम् । निरेके चिद्यो हरिवो वसुर्ददिः ॥
8.24.e: As such, when glorified, bring us riches of very wondrous fame,  Set in the highest rank, Wealth-giver, Lord of Bays!

8.24.d: आ निरेकमुत प्रियमिन्द्र दर्षि जनानाम् । धृषता धृष्णो स्तवमान आ भर ॥
8.24.e: Yea, Indra, thou disclosest that preeminent dear wealth of men:  Boldly, O Bold One, glorified, bring it to us.

8.24.d: न ते सव्यं न दक्षिणं हस्तं वरन्त आमुरः । न परिबाधो हरिवो गविष्टिषु ॥
8.24.e: The workers of destruction stay neither thy right hand nor thy left:  Nor hosts that press about thee, Lord of Bays, in fight.

8.24.d: आ त्वा गोभिरिव व्रजं गीर्भिर्ऋणोम्यद्रिवः । आ स्मा कामं जरितुरा मनः पृण ॥
8.24.e: O Thunder-armed, I come with songs to thee as to a stall with kine:  Fulfil the wish and thought of him who sings thy praise.

8.24.d: विश्वानि विश्वमनसो धिया नो वृत्रहन्तम । उग्र प्रणेतरधि षू वसो गहि ॥
8.24.e: Chief Vṛtra-slayer, through the hymn of Visvamanas think of all,  All that concerneth us, Excellent, Mighty Guide.

8.24.d: वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्विद्याम शूर नव्यसः । वसोः स्पार्हस्य पुरुहूत राधसः ॥
8.24.e: May we, O Vṛtra-slayer, O Hero, find this thy newest boon, Longed-for, and excellent, thou who art much invoked!

8.24.d: इन्द्र यथा ह्यस्ति तेऽपरीतं नृतो शवः । अमृक्ता रातिः पुरुहूत दाशुषे ॥
8.24.e: O Indra, Dancer, Much-invoked! as thy great power is unsurpassed,  So be thy bounty to the worshipper unchecked.

8.24.d: आ वृषस्व महामह महे नृतम राधसे । दृळ्हश्चिद्दृह्य मघवन्मघत्तये ॥
8.24.e: Most Mighty, most heroic One, for mighty bounty fill thee full.  Though strong, strengthen thyself to win wealth, Maghavan!

8.24.d: नू अन्यत्रा चिदद्रिवस्त्वन्नो जग्मुराशसः । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिः ॥
8.24.e: O Thunderer, never have our prayers gone forth to any God but thee:  So help us, Maghavan, with thine assistance now.

8.24.d: नह्य१ङ्ग नृतो त्वदन्यं विन्दामि राधसे । राये द्युम्नाय शवसे च गिर्वणः ॥
8.24.e: For, Dancer, verily I find none else for bounty, saving thee,  For splendid wealth and power, thou Lover of the Song.

8.24.d: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु । प्र राधसा चोदयाते महित्वना ॥
8.24.e: For Indra pour ye out the drops meath blent with Soma let him drink  With bounty and with majesty will he further us.

8.24.d: उपो हरीणां पतिं दक्षं पृञ्चन्तमब्रवम् । नूनं श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य ॥
8.24.e: I spake to the Bay Coursers' Lord, to him who gives ability:  Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee.

8.24.d: नह्य१ङ्ग पुरा चन जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् । नकी राया नैवथा न भन्दना ॥
8.24.e: Never was any Hero born before thee mightier than thou:  None certairdy like thee in goodness and in wealth.

8.24.d: एदु मध्वो मदिन्तरं सिञ्च वाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीरः स्तवते सदावृधः ॥
8.24.e: O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most:  So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us.

8.24.d: इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां नकिष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम् । उदानंश शवसा न भन्दना ॥
8.24.e: Indra, whom Tawny Coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent,  None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.

8.24.d: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः । अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम् ॥
8.24.e: We, seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and might  Who must be glorified by constant sacri fice.

8.24.d: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम सखायः स्तोम्यं नरम् । कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत् ॥
8.24.e: Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends, the Hero who deserves the laud,  Him who with none to aid o’ercomes all tribes of men.

8.24.d: अगोरुधाय गविषे द्युक्षाय दस्म्यं वचः । घृतात्स्वादीयो मधुनश्च वोचत ॥
8.24.e: To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, Celestial God,  Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than meath.

8.24.d: यस्यामितानि वीर्या३ न राधः पर्येतवे । ज्योतिर्न विश्वमभ्यस्ति दक्षिणा ॥
8.24.e: Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne’er may be surpassed,  Whose liberality, like light, is over all.

8.24.d: स्तुहीन्द्रं व्यश्ववदनूर्मिं वाजिनं यमम् । अर्यो गयं मंहमानं वि दाशुषे ॥
8.24.e: As Vyaśva did, praise Indra, praise the Strong unfluctuating Guide,  Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper.

8.24.d: एवा नूनमुप स्तुहि वैयश्व दशमं नवम् । सुविद्वांसं चर्कृत्यं चरणीनाम् ॥
8.24.e: Now, son of Vyaśva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new,  The very Wise, whom living men must glorify

8.24.d: वेत्था हि निर्ऋतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजम् । अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव ॥
8.24.e: Thou knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive powers,  As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.

8.24.d: तदिन्द्राव आ भर येना दंसिष्ठ कृत्वने । द्विता कुत्साय शिश्नथो नि चोदय ॥
8.24.e: O Indra, bring that aid wherewith of old, Most Wondrous! thou didst slay  His foes for active Kutsa: send it down to us.

8.24.d: तमु त्वा नूनमीमहे नव्यं दंसिष्ठ सन्यसे । स त्वं नो विश्वा अभिमातीः सक्षणिः ॥
8.24.e: So now we seek thee fresh in might, Most Wonderful in act! for gain:  For thou art he who conquers all our foes for us.

8.24.d: य ऋक्षादंहसो मुचद्यो वार्यात्सप्त सिन्धुषु । वधर्दासस्य तुविनृम्ण नीनमः ॥
8.24.e: Who will set free from ruinous woe, or Ārya on the Seven Streams:  O valiant Hero, bend the Dāsa's weapon down.

8.24.d: यथा वरो सुषाम्णे सनिभ्य आवहो रयिम् । व्यश्वेभ्यः सुभगे वाजिनीवति ॥
8.24.e: As to Varosusaman thou broughtest great riches, for their gain,  To Vyaśva's sons, Blest Lady, rich in ample wealth!

8.24.d: आ नार्यस्य दक्षिणा व्यश्वाँ एतु सोमिनः । स्थूरं च राधः शतवत्सहस्रवत् ॥
8.24.e: Let Narya's sacrificial meed reach Vyaśva's Soma-bearing sons:  In hundreds and in thousands be the great reward.

8.24.d: यत्त्वा पृच्छादीजानः कुहया कुहयाकृते । एषो अपश्रितो वलो गोमतीमव तिष्ठति ॥
8.24.e: If one should ask thee, Where is he who sacrificed? Whither lookest thou?  Like Vala he hath passed away and dwelleth now on Gomati.

8.25.d: ता वां विश्वस्य गोपा देवा देवेषु यज्ञिया । ऋतावाना यजसे पूतदक्षसा ॥
8.25.e: I WORSHIP you who guard this All, Gods, holiest among the Gods,  You, faithful to the Law, whose power is sanctified.

8.25.d: मित्रा तना न रथ्या३ वरुणो यश्च सुक्रतुः । सनात्सुजाता तनया धृतव्रता ॥
8.25.e: So, too, like charioteers are they, Mitra and sapient Varuṇa,  Sons high-born from of old, whose holy laws stand fast.

8.25.d: ता माता विश्ववेदसासुर्याय प्रमहसा । मही जजानादितिर्ऋतावरी ॥
8.25.e: These Twain, possessors of all wealth, most glorious, for supremest sway  Aditi, Mighty Mother, true to Law, brought forth.

8.25.d: महान्ता मित्रावरुणा सम्राजा देवावसुरा । ऋतावानावृतमा घोषतो बृहत् ॥
8.25.e: Great Varuṇa and Mitra, Gods, Asuras and imperial Lords,  True to Eternal Law proclaim the high decree.

8.25.d: नपाता शवसो महः सूनू दक्षस्य सुक्रतू । सृप्रदानू इषो वास्त्वधि क्षितः ॥
8.25.e: The offspring of a lofty Power, Dakṣa's Two Sons exceeding strong,  Who, Lords of flowing rain, dwell in the place of food.

8.25.d: सं या दानूनि येमथुर्दिव्याः पार्थिवीरिषः । नभस्वतीरा वां चरन्तु वृष्टयः ॥
8.25.e: Ye who have gathered up your gifts, celestial and terrestrial food,  Let your rain come to us fraught with the mist of heaven.

8.25.d: अधि या बृहतो दिवो३ऽभि यूथेव पश्यतः । ऋतावाना सम्राजा नमसे हिता ॥
8.25.e: The Twain, who from the lofty sky seem to look down on herds below,  Holy, imperial Lords, are set to be revered.

8.25.d: ऋतावाना नि षेदतुः साम्राज्याय सुक्रतू । धृतव्रता क्षत्रिया क्षत्रमाशतुः ॥
8.25.e: They, true to Law, exceeding strong, have sat them down for savran rule:  Princes whose laws stand fast, they have obtained their sway.

8.25.d: अक्ष्णश्चिद्गातुवित्तरानुल्बणेन चक्षसा । नि चिन्मिषन्ता निचिरा नि चिक्यतुः ॥
8.25.e: Pathfinders even better than the eye, with unobstructed sight,  Even when they close their lids, observant, they perceive.

8.25.d: उत नो देव्यदितिरुरुष्यतां नासत्या । उरुष्यन्तु मरुतो वृद्धशवसः ॥
8.25.e: So may the Goddess Aditi, may the Nāsatyas guard us well,  The Martits guard us well,.endowed with mighty strength.

8.25.d: ते नो नावमुरुष्यत दिवा नक्तं सुदानवः । अरिष्यन्तो नि पायुभिः सचेमहि ॥
8.25.e: Do ye, O Bounteous Gods, protect our dwelling lace by day and night:  With you for our defenders may we go unharmed.

8.25.d: अघ्नते विष्णवे वयमरिष्यन्तः सुदानवे । श्रुधि स्वयावन्त्सिन्धो पूर्वचित्तये ॥
8.25.e: May we, unharmed, serve bountiful Viṣṇu, the God who slayeth none:  Self-moving Sindhu hear and be the first to mark.

8.25.d: तद्वार्यं वृणीमहे वरिष्ठं गोपयत्यम् । मित्रो यत्पान्ति वरुणो यदर्यमा ॥
8.25.e: This sure protection we elect, desirable and reaching far,  Which Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman afford.

8.25.d: उत नः सिन्धुरपां तन्मरुतस्तदश्विना । इन्द्रो विष्णुर्मीढ्वांसः सजोषसः ॥
8.25.e: And may the Sindhu of the floods, the Maruts, and the ASvin Pair,  Boon Indra, and boon Viṣṇu have one mind with us.

8.25.d: ते हि ष्मा वनुषो नरोऽभिमातिं कयस्य चित् । तिग्मं न क्षोदः प्रतिघ्नन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
8.25.e: Because these warring Heroes stay the enmity of every foe,  As the fierce water-flood repels the furious ones.

8.25.d: अयमेक इत्था पुरूरु चष्टे वि विश्पतिः । तस्य व्रतान्यनु वश्चरामसि ॥
8.25.e: Here this one God, the Lord of men, looks forth exceeding far and wide:  And we, for your advantage, keep his holy laws.

8.25.d: अनु पूर्वाण्योक्या साम्राज्यस्य सश्चिम । मित्रस्य व्रता वरुणस्य दीर्घश्रुत् ॥
8.25.e: We keep the old accustomed laws, the statutes of supremacy,  The Iong-known laws of Mitra and of Varuṇa.

8.25.d: परि यो रश्मिना दिवोऽन्तान्ममे पृथिव्याः । उभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा ॥
8.25.e: He who hath measured with his ray the boundaries of heaven and earth,  And with his majesty hath filled the two worlds full,

8.25.d: उदु ष्य शरणे दिवो ज्योतिरयंस्त सूर्यः । अग्निर्न शुक्रः समिधान आहुतः ॥
8.25.e: Sūrya hath spread his light aloft up to the region of the sky,  Like Agni all aflame when gifts are offered him.

8.25.d: वचो दीर्घप्रसद्मनीशे वाजस्य गोमतः । ईशे हि पित्वोऽविषस्य दावने ॥
8.25.e: With him who sits afar the word is lord of food that comes from kine,  Controller of the gift of unempoisoned food.

8.25.d: तत्सूर्यं रोदसी उभे दोषा वस्तोरुप ब्रुवे । भोजेष्वस्माँ अभ्युच्चरा सदा ॥
8.25.e: So unto Sūrya, Heaven, and Earth at morning and at eve I speak.  Bringing enjoyments ever rise thou up for us.

8.25.d: ऋज्रमुक्षण्यायने रजतं हरयाणे । रथं युक्तमसनाम सुषामणि ॥
8.25.e: From Uksanyayana a bay, from Harayana a white steed,  And from Susaman we obtained a hamessed car.

8.25.d: ता मे अश्व्यानां हरीणां नितोशना । उतो नु कृत्व्यानां नृवाहसा ॥
8.25.e: These two shall bring me further gain of troops of tawny-coloured steeds,  The carriers shall they be of active men of war.

8.25.d: स्मदभीशू कशावन्ता विप्रा नविष्ठया मती । महो वाजिनावर्वन्ता सचासनम् ॥
8.25.e: And the two sages have I gained who hold the reins and bear the whip,  And the two great strong coursers, with my newest song.

8.26.d: युवोरु षू रथं हुवे सधस्तुत्याय सूरिषु । अतूर्तदक्षा वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
8.26.e: I CALL your chariot to receive united praise mid princely men,  Strong Gods who pour down wealth, of never vanquished might!

8.26.d: युवं वरो सुषाम्णे महे तने नासत्या । अवोभिर्याथो वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
8.26.e: Ye to Varosusaman come, Nāsatyas, for this glorious rite.  With your protecting aid. Strong Gods, who pour down wealth.
